budget_items.topic: Article 1 - FY27 school operating budget supplemental appropriation (school department article)
budget_items.what_was_said: The school department submitted an article to raise and appropriate an additional sum for the FY27 school operating budget.

budget_items.topic: Article 2 - citizens' petition to supplement FY27 school operating budget
budget_items.what_was_said: A citizens' petition article asks the town to raise and appropriate or transfer from available funds a sum of money to supplement the school department's FY27 operating budget; no dollar figure was stated in this article as read.

budget_items.topic: Article 3 - free cash/available funds transfer for athletics and transportation
budget_items.what_was_said: A citizens' petition article seeks to transfer a sum from certified free cash or available funds to the schools' FY27 operating budget to reinstate middle school sports and provide student-athlete transportation.
In discussing whether article two would duplicate article one, a board member speculated the town would not be putting in as large a sum as another figure mentioned.

budget_items.topic: Certified free cash availability for article 3
budget_items.what_was_said: The town manager explained that no certified free cash currently exists this early in the fiscal year and it is very unlikely to be certified before the September 3rd special town meeting; town counsel was being consulted on what other fund types might be in scope for the article's "available funds" language.

transfers.description: certified free cash or other available funds transferred to Lunenburg Public Schools' FY27 operating budget, for athletics/transportation

decisions.decision: The August 18th select board meeting will start at 6:00 p.m. (pushed back from 5:30) with a hard stop at 7:00 p.m. before a dog hearing.
The board will not meet on August 25th, keeping that week free.
The board's next regular meeting will be September 1st, which may include petitioners presenting their warrant articles to the select board.

minutes.summary: The Select Board voted to place the school committee's article on the warrant for the September 3rd special town meeting and then voted to approve the full warrant, which includes three articles addressing the FY27 school operating budget shortfall and reinstating middle school athletics/transportation. The town manager clarified that no certified free cash currently exists for one citizen-petition article and that town counsel was still reviewing which fund types are legally in scope; the board also set its meeting schedule through early September, including a September 1st session likely for petitioner presentations.
